portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

This update fixes the following bugs:

* Previously, Pacemaker could get into a fencing loop if a Pacemaker Remote node needed to be fenced while it was shutting down. With this update, the node is fenced once. (BZ#1732335)

* Pacemaker now allows users to configure the TLS cipher priorities, and uses a stricter subset by default. As a result, security scanners will no longer flag Pacemaker Remote servers as using older ciphers. (BZ#1733187)

Users of pacemaker are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs.
